competences.description: Swiftly attacks an enemy and weakens its defense for 1 turn with a 75% chance.

effets.description: The target's defense will be increased by 70%.

competences.description: Orders the ship to fire a bombardment of 3 rounds to attack random targets. Each hit has a 50% chance of stunning the enemy for 1 turn and a 50% chance to install a bomb that goes off after 2 turns.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

When remaining turns reach 0, the bomb explodes to deal damage that ignores Defense and stuns for 1 turn. The damage is affected by the caster's Attack Power, and the chance of stunning is affected by the caster's Accuracy and the target's Resistance.
